r03. Premise correction: there is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled in this codebase. The cron scheduler package at `internal/scheduler/` (see `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`) is a standalone, generic cron-scheduling library — its only usages are in its own test/example files (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`), which register illustrative jobs (e.g., `"0 2 * * *"`, `"0 9 * * *"` in the README/docs) purely for demonstration. No caller in the application wires up `scheduler.New()` with a database-cleanup job — `[ArchMap query]` returns a certified zero, and a search for vacuum/purge/retention logic across all Go files also found nothing. So there's no actual "nightly database-cleanup job" to report a time for.
